subject: Post-call: Acme TCO & cost levers (token economics, batching/caching)
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Ellis <j.ellis@acme.com>
Cc: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 10 May 2026 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call: Acme TCO & cost levers (token economics, batching/caching)

Thanks again for taking time today, Jordan — great conversation. Below is a short recap of pain, goals, and proposed next steps so we’re aligned. I attached a first-pass TCO estimate and our pricing overview.

Quick recap of pain & goals
- Primary pain: current reranking/assistant workload is driving unexpectedly high token spend and inconsistent latency for peak traffic.
- Secondary: procurement needs a predictable monthly spend (target ~ $25k/mo) and a 6-month ROI to justify an initial commitment.
- Tech goals: reduce per-request cost while keeping p95 latency under 350ms for user-facing endpoints; support bursts up to 300 concurrent requests.

Key levers we discussed (how Redwood helps)
- Token economics: model selection + quantization — run smaller model variants for 70% of traffic (cheap inference) and larger model for the top 30% of critical queries.
- Batching & adaptive batching: continuous batching for high-throughput routes to reduce per-token compute.
- KV/prefix caching: prefix and KV cache for repeated prompts (e.g., similar context across users) to avoid re-decoding tokens every call.
- Smart routing: route lower-priority traffic to lower-cost model variants or regionally cheaper GPUs.
- Dedicated vs Hosted tradeoffs: Dedicated reserved capacity reduces per-token compute for sustained volume; hosted gives flexibility for burst.

Preliminary numbers (high level)
- Current baseline (from what you shared): ~3.2M tokens/month across inference routes.
- Expected savings with a mixed approach (model routing + caching + batching): 40–60% on inference compute costs depending on cache hit-rate and batching efficiency.
- Next step: I attached a 1-page TCO with scenario A (hosted + caching) and scenario B (1x Dedicated GPU pool + batching). The spreadsheet has the line-item math.

Next steps / asks
- I’ll send an updated TCO with a 6-month ROI and two scenarios by EOD Tuesday (attached draft).
- You to confirm budget ceiling ($25k/mo) and the internal approval timeline.
- Schedule a 30-min follow-up to walk the numbers: suggested Wed 5/13 10:00am PT — does that work?

Attachments: acme_tco_estimate_v1.xlsx; redwood_pricing_overview.pdf
Drive: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1A2B3Cexample
HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/67890

Looking forward — I’ll prepare a couple ROI scenarios and a 1-page exec summary for your CFO.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
